name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey into motorsport catering was an unexpected turn after years in fine dining. Originally trained in Belgrade, she honed her skills in prestigious restaurants before a chance encounter with a Caterham team member at a local food festival. Impressed by her innovative approach to Serbian cuisine and logistical prowess, they offered her a role managing the Caterham Academy's catering. 

Milena believes that a well-fed team is a performing team. She emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients and balanced menus to fuel both body and mind. Her meticulous planning and resourcefulness ensures every team member, from drivers to engineers, has access to nutritious and delicious meals, no matter the location or time constraints. She's known for her ability to create comfort food with a healthy twist, a skill highly valued during demanding race weekends. What sets her apart is her dedication to bringing a taste of home to the team, boosting morale and fostering a sense of community.

physical.hairStyle: shoulder-length, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Milena is a sturdy woman with a warm smile and kind eyes that belie her demanding standards.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and ingredient lists.
Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served to the team.
Has a habit of humming traditional Serbian folk songs while preparing meals.
